title: AI gamedev will advance when we get a threejs that doesnt need the web.
author: FamiliarEstimate6267
selftext: I need this, im tired of sprite generators that cost credits and buying assets I want to have something we can actually download im tired of web based games

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
I don't see the problem. You can package it into a windows exec and put it on steam anyways. I think you can get really far even with just threejs.

This might be a problem if you want to make a true multiplayer AAA game perfectly optimized but that is beyond the scope of indie devs.

replies.author: Orlandogameschool
replies.body: Yea op doesn’t realize three,js games are a perfect starter for game development I really wish I started in web gl before trying to jump into unity years ago

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body: But ESPECIALLY with AI game dev, because the AI is trained on tons of three.js and is really good at making it look fantastic.

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Thee.js does not optimize well

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: You really need to be more specific, plenty of people have built plenty of impressive things with three.js, I really doubt it's your problem.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
https://reddit.com/link/p2irzbb/video/q6g642bwj7ih1/player

This is what i am building. It runs 200+ fps in chrome. 0 lag. 0 slutter.  
So again, unless you are going for AAA multiplayer game, optimization isn't a big issue.

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Can it run offline?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
It's a single player game.

The game is not released yet, but if one day i made it a windows exec package for steam then i'd expect it can be ran offline.

replies.author: Lavio00
replies.body: I don't get it, how does asset importing work with 3js? How did you actually go about making and importing all of those assets?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
You mean the characters?  
It's a GLB file produced with meshy.

There are no other "assets", Claude created it all with three.js

The reason is because AI sucks at making characters. OP's result is about as good as it gets.

replies.author: Lavio00
replies.body: So you put those in the project folder and claude can import them into 3js sessions?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Yes i tell claude "use Sarah.glb for my deckmate". Then he codes whatever he needs to code and it works.

What can be more complicated is if your game needs animations not included in the GLB. Then Claude will try to animate it, but it will usually suck on first shot.

replies.author: Orlandogameschool
replies.body:
Sounds like User error.  I’ve made crazy games with fps counter no lag all optimized 

People are optimizing whole production  for really nice 3d website to 3mb , I have a whole realistic ocean on my website it runs smooth

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: No one’s doing this, how would you go about building a game with three.js offline and optimizing it well?

comments.author: SpearHammer
comments.body: Why don't you build it with ai

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: :) totally haven’t thought of that…. Obviously I am

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body:
This is one if those "you don't know what you don't know" situations. 

Three.js only needs a browser of some sort, it certainly doesn't need the web.

Look into electron and its competitors.

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Hmm it isn’t that simple I’m aware of electron its optimization that is the issue

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
Optimization of what? the three.js code? or electron itself?

There are plenty of electron alternatives. You can also move to a full game engine like godot or unity if three.js isn't doing what you need.

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Godot can’t generate assets the way threejs can

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: The three.js code. Games played in browsers can most often be slow

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Also, I want something that is game engine agnostic in terms of assetgen majority of game engines definitely wouldn’t support threejs

comments.author: JCBAwesomist
comments.body: So I have my agent download the library for local use and distribution and that's legal so long as you include the 3.js licensing and credits in your credits. If you do that, no internet is required.

replies.author: FamiliarEstimate6267
replies.body: Ah wow thanks for thus
